title: 20 brand-ad candidates and 20 scriptwriting training guidelines
source: User-pasted curated list and training guide
source_verification: Candidate titles, claimed 30-second duration and specific assets not independently verified; some may be longer than 30 seconds

references.asset: Jim Sarbh — Not Everyone Gets CRED
Holi / Daag Achhe Hain (Brother & Sister Rickshaw)

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Find one human truth or specific friction instead of listing product features
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Use visual disruption, surprise or recognisable friction; do not force concealment of product
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Define who, where, what they are doing, and what is at stake
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Offer 0–8/8–18/18–25/25–30 as one possible arc, not mandatory
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Choose one dominant device, allow supporting mechanisms
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Avoid stock category clichés and generic smiling-family exposition
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Use immediately legible contrasting desires or behaviours
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Write overheard speech, brief interruptions, silences and purposeful lines
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Build feeling from contrast, believable behaviour and consequences
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Make product action causally necessary; choose timing by objective and duration
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Test first-view benefit clarity including muted playback where appropriate
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Replace exposition with expressive behaviour and visible action
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Use shot language to support story emotion and comprehension
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Match pace to dramatic or comic rhythm rather than default speed
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Specify subtle reactions and timing rather than generic expressions
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Use room tone, Foley, silence and sonic payoff intentionally
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Ground settings and wardrobe in credible lived-in specificity
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Choose a brand landing appropriate to campaign objective, not always gentle
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Use rewarding details and satisfying payoffs without obscuring first-view comprehension
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

scriptwriting_guidelines.guidance: Turn every insight into a reusable instruction for unrelated product briefs
scriptwriting_guidelines.source: user-supplied framework with explicitly noted training safeguards

training_cautions: Do not require product reveal in final third
Do not mandate one timecoded story structure
Do not require hiding the advertised product in first three seconds
Do not assume all listed commercials are 30 seconds
Verify original footage before asserting observed details
